## Checklist

- [ ] `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `gofmt -l .` are clean
- [ ] `go test ./...` and `go test -race ./...` pass
- [ ] `go run ./cmd/benchmark -quick` runs
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behavior
- [ ] If the change affects results: re-run as described in `CONTRIBUTING.md`, result files and manifests committed
- [ ] Documentation updated; every new number names its result file and says whether it is simulated
